posts.title: #SidewalkFriends: Rain Sword
posts.description: I like to keep an eye out for cool shapes during my walks and use them as inspiration for my #SidewalkFriends drawings. It’s like my version of hunting for Pokémon. This sword wielding samurai was inspired by some paint on the concrete after a big rain storm. posts.description: With the historic election results rolling in tonight, it seems like a good chance to share my tribute version of The Great Wave Off Kanagawa. I created this piece 4 years ago using Procreate, and it’s getting a ton of use over on Giphy lately, so I hope y’all enjoy it here too.
